# ethereum-optimism/specs Daily Update (Mar 5, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today, development focused on updating fault-proof documentation to align with recent changes in blob hint data specifications. An issue regarding `op-acceptance-tests` was closed, while discussions continued on a memory leak issue in `op-reth` and a new feature for `op-reth`'s transaction pool.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Documentation Updates
*   The blob hint data specification in the fault-proof documentation was updated to reflect changes from a related pull request in the `optimism` repository ([#890](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/pull/890)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
No new pull requests were opened today.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Test Suite Enhancements
*   An issue concerning the addition of more time control for the batcher and sequencer in `op-acceptance-tests` was closed, as the functionality was deemed unnecessary at this time ([#19009](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/issues/19009)).

## NEW ISSUES

### op-reth Feature Implementation
*   A new feature request was opened to implement interop transaction pool filtering and reorg eviction in `op-reth`, addressing functionalities currently present in `op-geth` ([#19411](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/issues/19411)).

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### op-reth Memory Leak Investigation
Discussions continued on the `op-reth` database read transaction memory leak issue ([#19212](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/issues/19212)). The latest comments indicate that the issue has not recurred in the last 7 days on `v1.10.2`, and the team plans to upgrade to `v1.11.0` soon to see if the problem persists.

### op-reth Interop Transaction Pool Features
A new issue was opened to implement interop-related transaction pool features in `op-reth` ([#19411](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/issues/19411)). The discussion has started with a question about the necessity of "Periodic re-validation" for these features.
